description: This PHP class 'FormatWithPurgeTime' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Maintenance\PurgeStrategy\FormatValue'. The class uses a trait 'DateTimeHelperTrait' to access date-time helper functions and provides a method 'getFormattedValue' that returns the current date and time, ignoring the input parameter.

classes.name: FormatWithPurgeTime
classes.description: A class that provides formatted date-time values to be used in purge strategies, specifically returning the current date and time.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the current date and time by utilizing the helper trait.
